mainland.q: Can I use RocProxy in mainland China?
mainland.a: No. RocProxy is for use outside mainland China only and is not available in mainland China.

plans.q: Dynamic or static residential: which should I choose?
plans.a: Dynamic residential is billed per GB and fits public data collection and large-scale verification. Static residential is rented per IP, dedicated or shared, and fits account operations that need a fixed IP.
